I tried to create the job, and I also tried to list existing automations so I wouldn't duplicate one, and both failed the same way. I can't tell whether a Pod end of day job already exists, so please check the Automations page before anyone retries.

Once the scheduler is reachable, I'll set it up as: weekdays at 17:30 America/Chicago (the company clock's time zone), reading #strategic-pod for that day's new messages and posting the note here. I haven't posted anything to the channel.

To unblock it, someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's auth configuration (`gateway.auth` in `/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`). Then ask me again and I'll create it.
